# Mainthread

> Mainthread is an AI productivity platform for high performers. It puts work, family and household on one timeline and builds a daily priority queue sized to the hours you actually have.

Website: https://www.mainthread.app/
App: https://run.mainthread.app
Contact: hello@mainthread.app
Pricing: free while v1 is being built, no credit card required.

## What it does

- **One timeline.** Swimlanes (work, household, family, personal) hold threads (long-running projects), which hold tasks. See what is in motion, who owns it, and where crunch weeks will land, from a few weeks to a full year.
- **Daily priority queue.** Every task is ranked by deadline and importance and sized against your real focus hours. Each task shows why it is in today's queue, and you are warned when you are over capacity.
- **Nothing slips.** Capture now, plan later. Put a task on hold without losing it or moving its dates.
- **Delegation.** Hand a task to someone else and keep it visible on your timeline.
- **Works with Claude.** Connect Claude through MCP to ask what is on today, add a task or move work, under the same rules as the app.

## How it differs

A to-do app lists what is next but hides deadlines, dependencies and how full your week is. A calendar shows what is booked but cannot tell you what matters. Mainthread combines both and ranks the work, so you know what to do today and why.

## Who it is for

High performers (executives, founders, owner-operators) who juggle many commitments across work and personal life and want one system instead of several disconnected tools.
